tools.name: health
tools.title: midnight-cast health
tools.description: Full check of a Midnight network: RPC and indexer reachability, indexer sync against the node, and live versions against the support matrix. data.examples says whether Midnight's own examples pass on the node the network runs. Start here when something might be wrong with the network rather than the user's code.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

threshold.description: Indexer lag, in blocks, that counts as out of sync (default 100)

tools.name: preflight
tools.title: midnight-cast preflight
tools.description: Check that a network, its proof server and optionally a wallet are ready before the first transaction: the network answers and is in sync, the proof server answers at the expected version, and the wallet holds NIGHT registered for DUST generation. data.expectations quotes how long wallet sync and restore took in Midnight's examples run, so a long first sync isn't mistaken for a hang.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

address.description: The wallet's Midnight unshielded address (mn_addr_…) or a Cardano reward address (stake…)

tools.name: ping
tools.title: midnight-cast ping
tools.description: Check whether the network's RPC node, indexer and proof server answer, with latency and a classified error kind for each failure.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

tools.name: tip
tools.title: midnight-cast tip
tools.description: Compare the node's latest block height with the indexer's, to see whether the indexer is behind.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

threshold.description: Lag in blocks that counts as out of sync (default 100)

tools.name: versions
tools.title: midnight-cast versions
tools.description: Compare the network's live node, runtime, indexer API and proof server with Midnight's support matrix, and a project's Midnight packages (package.json and package-lock.json) with the matrix pins. data.localProject says which directory was checked and whether it had a package.json, and data.examples whether Midnight's own examples pass on the node the network runs.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the user's project; defaults to the server's working directory, which may not be the project

checkLocalPackages.description: Check the project's packages at all (default true)

tools.name: block
tools.title: midnight-cast block
tools.description: Read a block header: the latest one, or the block at a height.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

height.description: Block height; omit for the latest block

tools.name: tx
tools.title: midnight-cast tx
tools.description: Look up a transaction on the indexer: status, segments, fees, contract actions and the DUST and Zswap events it produced.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

hash.description: Transaction hash, or an identifier when by is identifier

tools.name: dust_event
tools.title: midnight-cast dust-event
tools.description: Read one DUST ledger event by id from the indexer subscription.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

tools.name: dust_events
tools.title: midnight-cast dust-events
tools.description: Read DUST ledger events from the indexer: the latest ones, or a run starting at an id.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

from.description: First event id; omit for the latest events

limit.description: How many events to read (default 10, at most 50)

tools.name: contract
tools.title: midnight-cast contract
tools.description: Look up a deployed contract by address: whether it exists, its latest action (deploy, call or update) and the circuit a call ran, the deploy transaction and block (not reported after an update), unshielded balances, and the state's size and sha256.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

address.description: Contract address, hex, optionally prefixed with 0x

includeState.description: Also return the full state hex, which can be hundreds of kilobytes (default false)

tools.name: dust_status
tools.title: midnight-cast dust-status
tools.description: DUST generation for Cardano reward addresses: whether each is registered, its NIGHT balance, generation rate, and current and maximum DUST capacity. Use when a wallet has no DUST.

network.description: Midnight network to query: preview, preprod, mainnet, local

addresses.description: Cardano reward addresses (stake1… on mainnet, stake_test1… on test networks)

tools.name: decode
tools.title: midnight-cast decode
tools.description: Explain a Midnight error. Paste the whole message from a wallet, node, toolkit or Blockfrost: 1010 rejections, Custom(N) ledger codes, pallet errors, JSON-RPC codes and known tooling messages are recognised. A bare code such as 170 works too.

network.description: Network the error came from, to check the ledger map matches it

tools.name: explain
tools.title: midnight-cast explain
tools.description: Background on a Midnight topic: dust, 1010, versions, transcript, sync.

tools.name: examples
tools.title: midnight-cast examples
tools.description: Working code from Midnight's official examples (midnightntwrk/midnight-examples), each compiled and tested in CI. Give a topic such as "DUST sponsorship", "send shielded tokens" or "verify a signature in a circuit" to get the examples that show it, with file paths, line ranges, links pinned to a commit and the code itself. Without a topic, lists every example and what it covers. Prefer these over writing Midnight code from memory.

topic.description: What the code should show; omit to list every example
